# agents.ActivatePromptVersionInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Activates a prompt version (eval-gated; staff may force with a reason).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.ActivatePromptVersionInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.prompt.write` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `force` | no | `none` | Staff only: activate without a passing eval. |  |
| `reason` | no | `personal` | Required with force; kept on the activation. |  |
| `versionId` | yes | `none` | Version to activate. |  |
